about: The Linux rows for container tests, local (just linux-test, tools/linux-test.js) and CI (test.yml's test-containers, from `linux-test.js ci`: one list for both, parity T.1). Each distribution the Linux release needs (R-1), its oldest and newest supported release (D-c; parity 1c added apt's), named <distro>-<version>; `just linux-test <distro>` runs all of one distribution's rows. supported_until is the release's end of free security support, with its source (date null, with why, when none is published); past it linux-test and CI warn: drop the row. arch lists the CPUs the image has (Mint's: amd64 only). Every image is pinned by tag and digest; Renovate updates them behind the release-age gate. mise is the version the CI workflows pin, checked by its release's sha256.

rows.extra_why: Mint's image ships Ubuntu's base-files 13ubuntu10.5, which dpkg ranks above Mint's 13ubuntu10mint22.3.0, so its os-release says Ubuntu; this puts Mint's back, as a fresh install has it (owner, 2026-11-03)

supported_until.why: Mint's release page gives no end date, only 'Long term support release (LTS)' (2026-11-03)

rows.extra_why: Docker Hub's fedora:45 is the prerelease image (pushed 2026-11-02, the day before GA): fedora-repos 45-0.6 turns updates-testing on; the release's own fedora-repos 45-1 turns it off, as a fresh install has it (parity dnf 1a, 2026-11-11)
